VARIABLES pc, x, stack, a, local, b

vars == << pc, x, stack, a, local, b >>

Init == (* Global variables *)
        /\ x = 0
        (* Procedure First *)
        /\ a = 1
        /\ local = 2
        (* Procedure Last *)
        /\ b = 0
        /\ stack = << >>
        /\ pc = "E"

F == /\ pc = "F"
     /\ /\ b' = a
        /\ local' = Head(stack).local
        /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Last",
                         pc        |->  Head(stack).pc,
                         b         |->  b ] >>
                     \o Tail(stack)

     /\ UNCHANGED << x, a >>

First == F

T == /\ pc = "T"
     /\ pc' = Head(stack).pc
     /\ b' = Head(stack).b
     /\ stack' = Tail(stack)
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, a, local >>

Last == T

E == /\ pc = "E"
     /\ /\ a' = 3
        /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "First",
                         pc        |->  "B",
                         local     |->  local,
                         a         |->  a ] >>
                     \o stack
     /\ local' = 2
     /\ pc' = "F"
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, b >>

B == /\ pc = "B"
     /\ /\ b' = 4
        /\ stack' = << [ procedure |->  "Last",
                         pc        |->  "C",
                         b         |->  b ] >>
                     \o stack
     /\ pc' = "T"
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, a, local >>

C == /\ pc = "C"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"
     /\ UNCHANGED << x, stack, a, local, b >>

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == First \/ Last \/ E \/ B \/ C
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
